criteria.description: Designs a closed, self-reinforcing loop where product output feeds back as input to acquire/activate the next user — not a list of marketing channels or a linear funnel.
The loop runs through actual product usage (e.g. shared routes attract new runners), making it defensible, rather than bolted-on campaigns.
States the condition under which the loop compounds (k>1, LTV>CAC, content yield) and honestly assesses whether it holds.
Identifies the rate-limiting step/constraint to optimize first rather than optimizing everything at once.
Considers loop cycle time and/or distinguishes the primary loop from secondary loops/channels.
